page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of 1.0 thread per core. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent processing capabilities.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per CPU core. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

A key architectural tradeoff of this instance is the absence of local storage, requiring users to provision external block storage for operating systems and application data. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated x86_64 cores and an entry-level NVIDIA P4 GPU positions this server as a specialized option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the overhead of high-end GPU architectures.

Given the hardware profile, this instance is configured for entry-level GPU workloads, small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and general-purpose applications that benefit from parallel processing capabilities alongside a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio.
